author: _Phyre
body:
Ahem, I'm making another map... I stopped working on my current one, cause i feel like it is going to be hard to code. Now... Dont get me wrong, i do code, but not maps for MC... And for me it is totally different.

Now that we go that out of the way, i would like to ask... What is (In your opinion) the hardest & Easiest "gamemode" to code? Now Im going for Nexus, cause the kit has been already selected for you and basically all you have to do is the spawn area... (I might be wrong on that). And for me the hardest looks like Nebula, First of, the area of the map (Border), Ok to code, pretty simple, However. Spawn kits, and other sort involving that, are hard (In my opinion). But anyways, i just want to ask what is the easiest and hardest gamemode to code, and if Nexus turns out to be the easiest, i will try to code it, but if all fails, i might ask someone from either OCN, or Avicus to code for me :P. 

IGN:vsplesk101
Skype: (PM me in-game)
E-mail: (PM me in-game)

If you would like to code for me (if i need it, which should have a thread on it, if i DO need help) then please give me your skype, and i will send you my map. (If all goes well) :)
